title: Apassy provider file, schema version 1
description: One API provider (Stripe, GitHub, ...) for the declaration suggestions and the known hosts of the bouncer, or the general signals file. The files are in packs/providers/. The file name is <id>.json. This schema checks the structure. The loader in src/vault/providers.rs is the authority: `apassy-packs validate <file>` runs it. See docs/operations/declarations.md.

schema_version.description: The file format. This version of Apassy reads version 1 only.

provider_version.description: The version of the file content. It starts at 1. Increase it at each change.

id.description: A unique id. The file name is <id>.json.

kind.description: `provider`: one provider with known hosts (or `generic: true`). `general`: signals for every credential, such as production words. There is one general file.

label.description: The name that the app shows.

generic.description: A generic provider, such as a PostgreSQL URL of any host. A specific provider wins over it. Not for a general file.

known_hosts.description: Provider API hosts in lowercase. A host also covers its subdomains. Not for a general file. A generic provider may have an empty list.

host.description: A lowercase host name, such as api.stripe.com or localhost.

writtenList.description: Texts compared as written. Case matters.

lowercaseList.description: The detection compares lowercase text, so list items are lowercase.

claims.description: A map from a claim or field name to the texts that its value may be.

conditions.description: All conditions of a signal must hold. A list means one of the items. A value condition is the strongest signal for the provider, then a host, then a variable name, then a word.

value_shape.description: A field value is a prefix and a rest of a fixed form.

chars.description: The characters of the rest after the prefix. `token`: letters, digits, `-`, `_`, and `.`.

suggest.description: Declaration fields that the signal suggests. A general signal must suggest at least one field.

reason.description: Why the signal says what it says. The app shows it to the owner.
